title: Split a style file
summary: An import brings another Less file into the build.
introduction: An import brings another Less file into the build. Your task: Add a second variable to colours.less and use it.

Explain the example for split a style file

blocks.text: An import brings another Less file into the build. This helps keep shared choices separate from the styles that use them.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.

items: `@import` loads the named Less file so its shared variables are available while building this stylesheet.

blocks.text: With both files in one folder, the built h1 rule uses navy.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Save the labelled sections as separate files. A misspelled file path will stop the build.
